summary: Navigator queries the terminal for OSC4 colour support; if colours look wrong, use --osc4 false to keep terminal-defined colours. The site-artifact-<timestamp>.json files in the playbook directory are playbook artifacts created on every run, reviewable with ansible-navigator replay or :replay, and can be disabled or renamed in settings.
questions: Why does ansible-navigator mess up my terminal colours?
What are the artifact json files ansible-navigator creates in my playbook directory?
How do I stop ansible-navigator creating artifact files?
